items.title: Jean Bach interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: In my movie as a matter of fact, I think it’s Hank Jones says that you think he’s not going to play any higher and then he does.

ctx.x: Roy was one of the biggest competitors in the jam sessions.

That’s right. Yeah. In my movie as a matter of fact, I think it’s Hank Jones says that you think he’s not going to play any higher and then he does. Yeah, oh yes. He had to kill everybody with this business.
Now you, you were pretty into the Ellington band too.
